description: Journey — right after choosing the genre. The finished game of its genre is the default scope: its definition of done and what every game has (a way to win AND to lose, title / pause / end screens, sound, the genre HUD, touch controls, a loop playable from start to end) are required capabilities; exclude one only when the user explicitly asks (an endless game), and say so. Persist a versioned Game Completion Contract with revision checking. Read get_completion_report for its schema and a proposed contract. Required, optional and excluded capabilities describe the actual intended experience. 0 credits.

contract.description: GameCompletionContract matching the versioned schema returned by get_completion_report.

expected_revision.description: Revision of the saved contract as get_completion_report returns it (0 for the first definition): a stale revision is refused.
